A '''dream shimmer''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of large, buzzing [[Insect/Legends|insect]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jagomir]]. The insect's thorax and abdomen were about the size of a small [[Rodent/Legends|rodent]]. Dream shimmers were equipped with just one defensive mechanism&mdash;a stinger filled with [[Hallucination/Legends|hallucinogenic]] [[Poison/Legends|venom]], which they used to either allow themselves to escape from [[Diet/Legends|predators]] or repeatedly attack and stun enemies. The creature's name was derived from its [[Limb/Legends|wings]], which shimmered in the presence of light.<ref name="OAA1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The dream shimmer was mentioned in ''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]'', a [[2014]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying]] adventure published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] for use with the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]] system.<ref name="OAA1" />
